info.name: WorkBoard External Public Activity (Action Items) Activity (Action Items) Team API
Get a team or teams that the user token is a member of. If the token is a Data-Admin token, get all teams or a single team.

params.name: team_id
params.description: The unique numerical id assigned to each team in WorkBoard. If you do not include this parameter, the request will return all teams to which the authenticated user belongs.

params.name: id
params.description: This behaves the same as the `team_id` parameter above. Do not use both `id` and `team_id`.

params.name: external_id
params.description: This will get the team by its `external_id`. Do not use in combination with `id` or `team_id`.

params.name: role
params.description: Limit the teams returned based on whether the authenticated user is a team owner or member. Possible values: "owner", "member".

params.name: include
params.description: If the current authenticated user is an org data admin, pass this parameter with the value "org_teams" to return a dump of all organization teams.

params.name: created_at_range
params.description: Return teams with creation dates in the specified range. Dates must be formatted as UTC timestamps and comma-separated: startdate,enddate

params.name: updated_at_range
params.description: Return teams with last modified dates in the specified range. Dates must be formatted as UTC timestamps and comma-separated: startdate,enddate

params.name: offset
params.description: Specify the starting point for the results returned. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of teams returned per page. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 15.

items.docs: Get a team or teams that the user token is a member of. If the token is a Data-Admin token, get all teams or a single team.

Change the name of a team, add new and existing users to the team roster, change a member's role on the team, remove users from the team, or add new Workstreams. If you are using a personal access token, you must be the manager of the team to use this request.
Note: If you update a team with a new manager, the previous manager will be demoted to a co-manager.
